narrative.details: Preparations for the impending war at Ahn'Qiraj are proceeding, Champion. However, to ensure that we do not fall behind, or at least that I am not the one that causes us to fall behind, I want for you to bring back another stack of rugged leather. Your prompt attention to this matter will be greatly appreciated, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Rugged Leather to Doctor Serratus at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Practice, practice, practice. A well honed knife and the skill to use it will get you far in this world, adventurer. Looks like the edges on these skins are better than the last. Did you buy a new knife?

In any case, we thank you for your efforts. Your donation has been noted, and will be put to good use I can assure you. Should you find yourself in the possession of more rugged leather, be sure to come back and speak with me, as I will probably need it.
